howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Build and publish your restaurant menu in five simple steps.

steps.title: Create Categories
steps.description: Add categories like Starters, Mains, Desserts, and Drinks to organize your menu. You can create as many categories as you need and reorder them with drag and drop.

steps.title: Add Menu Items
steps.description: Enter the dish name, description, and price for each item. Mark allergens if applicable — guests will see allergen icons on the menu automatically.

steps.title: Upload or Generate Photos
steps.description: Upload your own food photos from your phone or computer, or use AI to generate a professional food image from the dish name. Images are optimized automatically.

steps.title: Organize with Drag and Drop
steps.description: Reorder categories and items by dragging them into place. Toggle any item on or off without deleting it — perfect for daily specials or sold-out dishes.

steps.title: Publish Your Menu
steps.description: Changes appear instantly on your live QR menu. There's no 'publish' button — every edit goes live in real time. Print your QR code and place it on your tables.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about creating your QR menu.

items.question: How do I create a QR menu for my restaurant?
items.answer: Sign up with your email, name your restaurant, and start adding categories and dishes. Your QR menu is generated automatically — print the QR code and place it on your tables.

items.question: Can I add photos to my menu items?
items.answer: Yes. Upload photos directly from your phone or computer. Images are automatically optimized for fast loading on any device.

items.question: How many items can I add?
items.answer: There is no limit on categories or menu items. Add as many dishes as you need — your menu stays fast and organized.

items.question: Can I temporarily hide a dish that's sold out?
items.answer: Yes. Toggle any item off with one tap. It disappears from the public menu but stays in your dashboard — toggle it back on whenever you're ready.

items.question: Can I add allergen information to dishes?
items.answer: Yes. Each menu item has an allergens field where you can select from common allergens like gluten, nuts, dairy, and more. Allergen icons appear automatically on the public menu.

items.question: Can I set different prices for different sizes?
items.answer: Each menu item has one price field. For items with size variations, you can create separate items (e.g., 'Pizza Small' and 'Pizza Large') or mention sizes in the description.

items.question: Do I need to reprint QR codes when I change the menu?
items.answer: No. Your QR code always points to your live menu. Any changes you make — new items, updated prices, hidden dishes — appear instantly without reprinting.

items.question: Can I organize items into subcategories?
items.answer: The menu uses a flat category structure for simplicity. You can create as many categories as needed — for example, 'Red Wine', 'White Wine', and 'Sparkling' instead of a single 'Wine' category.
